item.title: Posco Holdings Q1 Operating Profit Up 24%... Driven by Full-Scale Commercial Lithium Production (포스코홀딩스, 1분기 영업익 24% 증가…리튬 상업생산 본격화 덕)
item.description:
Posco Holdings reported a 24.5% increase in operating profit for the first quarter (January to March) of this year compared to the same period last year. Although profits in the steel sector declined due to higher raw material costs, a reduced deficit in the secondary battery materials segment is seen as driving the overall improvement in performance. (포스코홀딩스의 올해 1분기(1~3월) 영업이익이 지난해 같은 기간보다 24.5% 증가한 것으로 나타났다. 원료비 상승 영향으로 철강 부문 이익은 감소했지만, 이차전지소재 부문의 적자 폭이 줄면서 전체 실적이 개선된 것으로 풀이된다.)

Posco Holdings announced on the 30th that its consolidated operating profit for the first quarter of this year was provisionally tallied at 707 billion won, a 24.5% increase from the same period last year. Sales rose 2.5% to 17.876 trillion won over the same period. (포스코홀딩스는 연결 기준 올해 1분기 영업이익이 전년 동기 대비 24.5% 증가한 7070억원으로 잠정 집계됐다고 30일 공시했다. 매출액은 17조8760억원으로 같은 기간 2.5% 늘었다.)

The operating loss in the secondary battery materials segment narrowed significantly to 7 billion won, compared to a loss of 98 billion won a year earlier. In particular, the lithium subsidiary Posco Argentina, with the commencement of full-scale commercial production, saw its deficit shrink from 54 billion won to 18 billion won year-on-year. A company official stated, “Due to continued increases in production volume and selling prices, Posco Argentina recorded its first monthly profit in March, and a first quarterly profit is expected in Q2,” adding, “Posco HY Clean Metal achieved its first quarterly operating profit through sustained maximum operation and cost reductions.” Posco Future M also saw operating profit rise 5.9% to 18 billion won, driven by expanded sales in new cathode material markets and increased sales of high-value products. (이차전지소재 부문의 영업손실이 70억원으로, 1년 전(-980억원)과 견줘 적자 폭이 대폭 줄어들었다. 특히 리튬 자회사 포스코아르헨티나가 상업생산을 본격화하면서 적자 규모가 1년 새 540억원에서 180억원으로 축소됐다. 회사 관계자는 “포스코아르헨티나는 생산량과 판매가격의 지속 상승으로 3월에 최초로 월 단위 흑자를 기록했고 2분기 첫 분기 흑자가 예상된다”며 “포스코에이치와이(HY)클린메탈은 최대 가동 지속 유지 및 원가 절감 등으로 첫 분기 영업흑자를 기록했다”고 말했다. 포스코퓨처엠도 양극재 신규 시장 판매 확대 및 고부가 제품 판매 증가에 따라 영업이익이 180억원으로 5.9% 늘었다.)

The infrastructure segment saw its first-quarter operating profit increase by approximately 33% year-on-year to 405 billion won. The company explained that Posco International showed strong sales across its gas, energy, and other businesses, while Posco E&C returned to profitability as one-time costs were resolved. (인프라 부문은 1분기 영업이익이 4050억원으로 전년 동기 대비 33%가량 증가했다. 회사는 포스코인터내셔널이 가스, 에너지 등 사업 전반에서 판매 호조를 보였고 포스코이앤씨는 일회성 비용이 해소되면서 흑자로 돌아섰다고 설명했다.)

In the steel segment, profits declined due to increased logistics and raw material costs from a rise in exchange rates driven by risks from the Middle East war. Posco's operating profit fell 38.4% from a year earlier to 213 billion won. A company official forecasted, “If geopolitical risks in the Middle East are resolved, considering the time lag in cost reflection, profits are expected to gradually improve from the second half of the year.” (철강 부문은 중동 전쟁 리스크로 환율이 상승하면서 물류비와 원료비 부담이 커져 이익이 감소했다. 포스코 영업이익은 1년 전보다 38.4% 줄어든 2130억원으로 나타났다. 회사 관계자는 “중동 지정학적 리스크가 해소되면 원가 반영 시차를 고려할 때 하반기부터는 이익이 점진적으로 개선될 것”이라고 내다봤다.)

On the same day, Posco Holdings also announced a new three-year mid-term shareholder return policy effective from this year through 2028. The company decided to introduce a performance-linked shareholder return policy starting this year, based on adjusted net profit attributable to controlling interests, taking into account intensive future growth investments in steel and energy materials. The target shareholder return ratio is set at 35-40% of net profit attributable to controlling interests. (이날 포스코홀딩스는 올해부터 2028년까지 적용되는 새로운 3개년 중기 주주환원정책도 발표했다. 회사는 철강, 에너지소재 등 집중적인 미래 성장 투자를 고려해 올해부터 조정 지배지분순이익 기준의 성과연동형 주주환원정책을 도입하기로 했다. 주주환원율 목표는 지배지분순이익 대비 35~40% 수준이다.)

During a conference call, Posco Holdings stated that regarding the decision to directly employ approximately 7,000 subcontract workers, some cost increases are inevitable, but the scale will not be significant. A company official said, “While welfare costs will increase to some extent, unifying the chain of command and simplifying the cooperation structure after direct employment will enhance production efficiency, greatly contributing to strengthening the company's competitiveness, and we do not foresee a significant increase in costs.” (포스코홀딩스는 이날 콘퍼런스콜에서 하청노동자 7천여명을 직고용하기로 한 것과 관련해 일부 비용 상승은 불가피하지만, 그 규모는 크지 않을 것이라고 했다. 회사 관계자는 “복리후생비는 일부 증가하겠지만, 직고용 이후 지휘 감독 체계가 일원화하고 협력 구조가 단순화하면 생산 효율성이 높아지면서 회사 경쟁력 강화에 큰 도움이 될 것이고 비용적인 면에서 크게 증가하는 것은 없을 것으로 본다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the cost increase from the operation of the new electric arc furnace in Gwangyang, he stated, “We plan to start operations at 5-10% capacity and gradually increase in line with demand growth. We estimate that operating at 10% capacity will increase annual costs by about 70-80 billion won, but as sales volume will also rise accordingly, the impact on profit and loss is expected to be much smaller.” Posco is set to begin operation of the new Gwangyang electric arc furnace in June, with an annual production capacity of 2.5 million tons. This is part of a plan to establish a low-carbon crude steel production system. (그는 광양 신규 전기로 가동에 따른 비용 증가에 대해서는 “5~10% 정도로 가동하기 시작해서 수요 증가분에 맞춰 점진적으로 가동을 늘려갈 계획”이라며 “10% 가동 시 연간 700~800억원 정도 원가가 오를 것으로 보고 있는데, 그만큼 판매량도 늘어나기 때문에 손익에 미치는 영향은 훨씬 적을 것으로 예상한다”고 했다. 포스코는 오는 6월 연간생산 250만톤 규모의 광양 신규 전기로 가동을 앞두고 있다. 이를 통해 저탄소 조강 생산체제를 구축한다는 구상이다.)

Reporter Yuhayoung yhy@hani.co.kr (유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Samsung Heavy Industries Q1 Operating Profit Up 122%… "Increased LNG Carrier Construction" (삼성중공업, 1분기 영업이익 122%↑…“LNG선 건조 증가”)
item.description:
Samsung Heavy Industries announced on the 30th that its operating profit for the first quarter (January to March) of this year, based on preliminary consolidated results, stood at 273.1 billion won, a 122% increase compared to the same period last year. Revenue for the same period was tentatively tallied at 2.9023 trillion won, up 16% year-on-year. (삼성중공업은 올해 1분기(1~3월) 연결 기준 실적을 잠정 집계한 결과 영업이익이 2731억원으로 전년 동기 대비 122% 증가했다고 30일 공시했다. 같은 기간 매출액은 16% 증가한 2조9023억원으로 잠정 집계됐다.)

The company explained that the strong performance was driven by increased construction of high-profit core vessel types such as liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers in the shipbuilding sector, as well as the expansion of its global production base diversification strategy. (회사는 조선 부문에서 액화천연가스(LNG) 운반선 등 고수익 주력 선종의 건조가 늘고, 글로벌 생산거점 다각화 전략도 확대되면서 실적이 견조한 흐름을 보였다고 설명했다.)

The offshore sector also contributed to revenue growth as work on floating liquefied natural gas production, storage, and offloading (FLNG) projects, including the ZLNG in Malaysia, Cedar in Canada, and Coral in Mozambique, gained full momentum. (해양 부문도 말레이시아 제트엘엔지(ZLNG), 캐나다 시더, 모잠비크 코랄 등 부유식액화천연가스 생산저장하역설비(FLNG) 프로젝트 공정이 본격화하면서 매출 증가에 기여했다.)

A Samsung Heavy Industries official stated, "Due to the increase in production volume, revenue is expected to rise further starting from the second quarter," adding, "We will strengthen the foundation for stable profit generation based on a solid order backlog covering more than three years." (삼성중공업 관계자는 “생산 물량 확대 영향으로 2분기부터 매출액은 더욱 증가할 전망”이라며 “3년 치 이상 양호한 수주 잔고를 기반으로 안정적 수익 창출 토대를 다지겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Socar Partners with Krafton to Launch 150 Billion Won Autonomous Driving Company (쏘카, 크래프톤 손잡고 1500억원 규모 ‘자율주행 법인’ 추진)
item.description:
Car-sharing company Socar is joining forces with gaming firm Krafton to establish the nation's largest autonomous driving business entity, valued at 150 billion won. The plan is to accelerate the commercialization of autonomous driving services by leveraging mobility platform operational experience and data assets. (차량 공유 기업 쏘카가 게임 기업 크래프톤과 손잡고 1500억원 규모의 국내 최대 자율주행 사업 법인을 설립한다. 모빌리티 플랫폼 운영 경험과 데이터 자산을 바탕으로 자율주행 서비스 상용화에 속도를 낸다는 계획이다.)

Socar announced on the 30th that it will receive 65 billion won in investment from Krafton through a third-party allotment capital increase, which will serve as the foundation for establishing an autonomous driving corporation. With this investment, Krafton will become Socar's third-largest shareholder while also making separate investments in the new entity. Socar also plans to hold a board meeting soon to decide on contributing cash and data assets for the establishment of the new corporation. (쏘카는 30일 크래프톤으로부터 제3자 배정 유상증자 방식으로 650억원 규모의 투자를 받아, 이를 기반으로 자율주행 법인 설립을 추진한다고 밝혔다. 크래프톤은 이번 투자로 쏘카의 3대 주주로 합류하는 동시에, 신설 법인에도 별도 투자를 진행할 예정이다. 쏘카 역시 신설 법인 설립을 위해 조만간 이사회를 열어 현금과 데이터 자산 출자를 결정할 계획이다.)

The new company is expected to be established in May, and Socar CEO Park Jae-wook, who has been overseeing the autonomous driving new business since January this year, will serve concurrently as the CEO of the new entity, leading the venture. (신규 법인은 5월 중 설립될 예정이며, 올해 1월부터 자율주행 신사업을 총괄해온 박재욱 쏘카 대표가 신설 법인 대표를 겸직하며 사업을 이끌게 된다 .)

Socar's Future Mobility Task Force (TF), established earlier this year, collected approximately 1.1 million kilometers of real-world driving data per day in the first quarter (January to March), based on 25,000 car-sharing vehicles. Through this, the company secured various driving data, including 220,000 accident-related records, and has been processing it to enable immediate use for training autonomous driving artificial intelligence (AI). (쏘카가 올해 초 신설한 미래이동 태스크포스(TF)는 지난 1분기(1~3월) 동안 2만5000대의 카셰어링 차량을 기반으로 하루 약 110만km의 실주행 데이터를 수집했다. 이를 통해 회사는 22만건에 이르는 사고 정보를 포함한 다양한 주행 데이터를 확보, 자율주행 인공지능(AI) 학습에 즉시 활용할 수 있도록 가공 작업을 진행해왔다.)

The new corporation plans to gradually expand its business, starting with a Level 2 car-sharing service that assists drivers, up to a Level 4 service capable of autonomous driving without driver intervention in specific areas or conditions. Additionally, it aims to establish a foundation for the domestic autonomous driving service business by seeking external partnerships. (신규 법인은 운전자를 보조하는 레벨2 수준의 카셰어링 서비스를 시작으로 , 특정 구역이나 조건에서 운전자 개입 없이 자율주행이 가능한 레벨4 수준의 서비스까지 단계적으로 사업을 확대할 계획이다. 이와 함께 외부 파트너십을 모색해 국내 자율주행 서비스 사업 기반을 마련한다는 구상 이다.)

Krafton CEO Kim Chang-han stated during the first-quarter earnings call on the same day, "The new company will independently pursue its autonomous driving business through AI research and development, while Krafton plans to conduct separate physical AI research based on the data secured in this process." He added, "Since Socar has extensive experience managing large-scale vehicles and drivers offline through its past 'Tada' service, we believe it is the most competitive operator once autonomous driving services are commercialized." (김창한 크래프톤 대표는 이날 1분기 실적발표회에서 “신설 법인이 독자적으로 인공지능 연구·개발을 통해 자율주행 사업을 추진하고, 크래프톤은 이 과정에서 확보된 데이터를 기반으로 별도의 피지컬 인공지능 연구를 진행할 계획”이라며 “쏘카는 과거 ‘타다’ 서비스를 통해 오프라인에서 차량과 운전자를 대규모로 관리한 경험을 보유한 만큼, 자율주행 서비스가 상용화됐을 때 가장 경쟁력 있는 사업자가 될 수 있는 회사라고 판단했다”고 말했다.)

Socar CEO Park Jae-wook said, "Our goal goes beyond just perfecting autonomous driving technology; it is about successfully commercializing it to fundamentally change users' travel habits and quality of life." He added, "With 15 years of data and operational know-how built through car-sharing, we will create new standards for the future mobility market." (박재욱 쏘카 대표는 “우리의 목표는 단순한 자율주행 기술의 완성을 넘어, 이를 성공적으로 상용화해 이용자들의 이동 습관과 삶의 질을 근본적으로 변화시키는 것”이라며 “쏘카가 카셰어링으로 다져온 15년간의 데이터와 운영 노하우를 발판 삼아 미래 이동 시장의 새로운 표준을 만들어가겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Seon Dam-eun sun@hani.co.kr (선담은 기자 sun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government: "Naphtha supply in May expected to recover to 80-90% of pre-war levels" (정부 “5월 나프타 확보 물량, 전쟁 전 대비 80~90% 회복될 것”)
item.description:
Naphtha supply, which faced disruptions due to the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, is expected to stabilize starting in May. Thanks to government financial support and the discovery of alternative supply chains, there is a sense of easing in securing raw materials. (호르무즈해협 봉쇄로 공급 차질이 빚어졌던 나프타 수급이 5월부터 안정을 되찾을 전망이다. 정부의 재정 지원과 대체 공급망 발굴에 따른 영향으로 원료 확보에 다소 숨통이 트이는 분위기다.)

Yang Ki-wook, head of the Industrial Resource Security Office at the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, said at a briefing at the Sejong Government Complex on the 30th, "We have injected 677.4 billion won of supplementary budget to support 50% of the import price differential for approximately 700,000 tons of naphtha, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), condensate (ultra-light crude), and basic petrochemical feedstocks, starting from contracts signed on the 1st." Naphtha, used as a key raw material for petrochemical products such as plastics, cosmetics, and vinyl, is often called the "rice of industry." (양기욱 산업통상부 산업자원안보실장은 30일 정부세종청사에서 브리핑을 열어 “추가경정예산 6774억원을 투입해 지난 1일 계약분부터 나프타와 액화석유가스(LPG), 콘덴세이트(초경질유), 기초유분 약 70만톤(t)의 수입 단가 차액 50%를 지원했다”고 밝혔다. 나프타는 플라스틱과 화장품, 비닐 등 석유화학 제품의 핵심 원료로 쓰여 ‘산업의 쌀’로 불린다.)

As a result, the pace of importing naphtha-related volumes has accelerated. According to the government, contracts signed over the entire month of March were completed within just two weeks in April, showing a promotional effect on imports. Director Yang predicted, "Considering that we are continuously bringing in basic feedstocks from China as well, the volume of naphtha secured in May is expected to recover to 80-90% of pre-Middle East war levels." (이에 따라 나프타 관련 물량 수입 속도가 빨라졌다. 지난 3월 한 달간 체결된 계약 물량이 4월에는 보름 만에 완료되는 등 수입 촉진 효과가 나타나고 있다는 것이 정부 설명이다. 양 실장은 “중국에서도 기초유분을 지속해서 도입하고 있는 상황까지 고려하면, 5월 나프타 확보 물량이 중동 전쟁 이전 대비 80~90% 수준까지 회복될 것”이라고 내다봤다.)

The government and the petrochemical industry have reduced dependence on the Middle East and shifted import sources to the U.S. and India. The U.S., which was the 7th largest import source before the Middle East war, has now risen to the top with 24.7% of total import volume. This is followed by India (23.2%), Algeria (14.5%), the United Arab Emirates (UAE, 10.2%), and Greece (4.5%), marking a complete shift in the import landscape. Before the war, the Middle East dominated with the UAE (23.5%), Algeria (15.6%), Qatar (12.6%), Kuwait (8.8%), and India (7.9%) in that order. However, the government remains cautious about whether this supply chain restructuring will persist after the war. Director Yang stated, "The naphtha market is separate from the crude oil market and is highly sensitive to prices, making it too early to discuss structural changes." This suggests that, unlike crude oil where there are ongoing efforts to diversify supply chains after the Middle East war, naphtha's dependence on the Middle East could rise again. (정부와 석화업계는 중동 의존도를 낮추고 미국·인도로 수입선을 돌렸다. 중동전쟁 발발 이전 수입국 순위 7위였던 미국은 최근 전체 수입 비중의 24.7%를 차지하며 최대 수입국으로 올라섰다. 이어 인도(23.2%), 알제리(14.5%), 아랍에미리트(UAE·10.2%), 그리스(4.5%) 등의 순서로 수입 지형이 완전히 바뀌었다. 전쟁 전에는 아랍에미리트(23.5%), 알제리(15.6%), 카타르(12.6%), 쿠웨이트(8.8%), 인도(7.9%) 순으로 중동 비중이 절대적이었다. 다만, 정부는 전쟁 이후에도 이런 공급망 재편이 지속될지에 대해선 신중한 입장이다. 양 실장은 “나프타 시장은 원유 시장과 분리돼 있고, 가격에 아주 민감해 구조적 변화를 논하기는 아직 이르다”고 했다. 원유의 경우 중동 전쟁 이후에도 공급망 다각화를 지속하려는 움직임이 있는 것과는 달리, 나프타의 중동 의존도가 다시 높아질 수 있음을 시사한 것이다.)

Domestic petrochemical companies are slightly increasing the operating rates of their naphtha cracking centers (NCC). Daehan Oil & Petrochemical announced the day before that it would preemptively raise its NCC operating rate from 62% to 72%. Earlier, Yeochun NCC also announced on the 27th that it would raise its plant operating rate from 60% to 65%. Director Yang said, "We expect other petrochemical companies to gradually increase operating rates or restart facilities that were shut down, starting in May," adding, "The NCC operating rate in Korea dropped to 55% due to the war, but we anticipate it will recover to around 70% starting in May." (국내 석화 기업들은 나프타 분해시설(NCC) 가동률을 소폭 올리고 있다. 대한유화는 전날 엔시시 가동률을 기존 62%에서 72%까지 선제적으로 상향 조정한다고 밝혔다. 앞서 여천엔시시도 지난 27일 공장 가동률을 기존 60%에서 65%로 상향 조정한다고 밝힌 바 있다. 양 실장은 “5월 중 다른 석화사들도 하나둘씩 가동률을 높이거나 가동을 중단했던 설비를 재가동할 것으로 전망한다”며 “전쟁으로 국내 엔시시 가동률이 55%까지 떨어졌었는데, 5월부터는 70% 수준으로 회복할 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Jae-ho ph@hani.co.kr (이재호 기자 ph@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Naver’s All-In Move with ‘Unlimited Free Shipping’—Retaining Customers Who Fled Coupang and Are Now Returning (네이버 ‘무제한 무료배송’ 승부수…‘탈팡’→‘돌팡’ 고객 붙들기)
item.description:
Naver plans to introduce an ‘unlimited free shipping’ service for its membership subscribers in the second half of this year. This strategy is interpreted as an effort to bolster its delivery competitiveness and prevent user churn, following the so-called ‘Coupang Exodus’ customers—who had shifted to Naver Shopping after Coupang’s massive personal data breach late last year—recently showing signs of returning to Coupang. <<> Naver CEO Choi Soo-yeon stated at the first-quarter earnings call on the 30th, “Our top priority for this year’s commerce strategy is strengthening delivery competitiveness,” adding, “We plan to introduce an unlimited free shipping service linked to our membership in the second half of the year.” With Coupang’s ‘Rocket Delivery’ speed proving difficult to match in the short term, Naver aims to differentiate itself by offering free shipping benefits at a lower price than Coupang’s ‘Wow Membership’ (7,890 won per month). The subscription fee for ‘Naver Plus Membership’ is 4,900 won per month. <<> Behind Naver’s push for ‘unlimited free shipping’ lies a recent slowdown in the ‘Coupang Exodus’ trend. According to data from WiseApp·Retail, a real-time app and payment analytics firm, Coupang’s estimated payment amount in March reached 5.7136 trillion won, breaking a three-month decline following the personal data breach in November last year and recovering to pre-incident levels. <<> Industry observers view Naver’s move as a preemptive investment to curb the recent signs of users—who flocked to Naver Shopping as a ‘Coupang alternative’ starting last December—leaving again. In fact, in the first quarter of this year (January–March), the transaction volume of the ‘Naver Plus Store’ app increased by 28% compared to the previous quarter, while the fresh food grocery service ‘Curlie N Mart’ saw its transaction volume roughly triple over the same period. However, it remains uncertain whether this trend will continue into the second quarter (April–June). <<> Competitors raise concerns over the cost burden and potential for a price war stemming from the introduction of unlimited free shipping. An industry insider commented, “Naver likely doesn’t want to miss the commerce revenue growth opportunity gained from Coupang’s misfortune,” adding, “While profitability may take a short-term hit from unlimited free shipping, absorbing ex-Coupang users could expand its long-term revenue base.” <<> Naver also revealed today that it is considering direct investment in its own logistics network over the medium to long term. CEO Choi stated, “We are actively reviewing a direct investment model for logistics” to strengthen delivery competitiveness. Although specific plans have not yet been finalized, Naver explained that decisions on direct investment will be made after considering factors such as reducing per-delivery costs and securing logistics data. <<> Additionally, Naver plans to expand the coverage of ‘N Delivery,’ which guarantees product arrival on a promised date and time—primarily for daily essentials—to over 25% within the year, while also introducing a ‘direct contract model’ that involves signing logistics agreements directly with sellers. Through 14 partner logistics companies including CJ Logistics, Naver provides fulfillment services to sellers. While it does not involve directly purchasing products like Coupang, the company says this structure integrates storage, sorting, and delivery processes to improve delivery speed and inventory management efficiency. <<> Meanwhile, Naver’s stock price closed at 211,000 won on this day, down 4.09% (9,000 won) from the previous trading day. <<> Reporter Seon Dam-eun sun@hani.co.kr (네이버가 올 하반기 자사 멤버십 회원을 대상으로 ‘무제한 무료배송’ 서비스를 도입한다. 지난해 말 쿠팡의 대규모 개인정보 유출 사태 이후 네이버 쇼핑으로 이동했던 이른바 ‘탈팡’ 고객들이 최근 다시 쿠팡으로 돌아가는 움직임(돌팡)이 나타나자, 배송 경쟁력을 강화해 이용자 이탈을 막겠다는 전략으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: Samsung Electronics Posts 57 Trillion Won in Q1 Operating Profit, Surpassing Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta (삼성전자, 1분기 영익 57조원…MS·아마존·메타 제쳐)
item.description:
Samsung Electronics recorded an operating profit of 53.7 trillion won in the semiconductor sector in the first quarter of this year, the largest ever. The company's total operating profit, driven by memory semiconductors, reached 57 trillion won, surpassing the operating profits of global big tech companies such as Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta. These big tech firms are expected to pour over 1,000 trillion won in investments into AI infrastructure this year, fueling a semiconductor boom. (삼성전자가 올해 1분기 반도체 부문에서 사상 최대 규모인 53조7천억원의 영업이익을 올렸다. 메모리 반도체가 이끈 전사 영업이익은 57조원에 이르며 미국 마이크로소프트(MS), 아마존, 메타 등 글로벌 빅테크(거대 기술기업)의 영업이익을 넘어섰다. 빅테크들은 올해도 인공지능(AI) 인프라에 1천조원 이상의 투자금을 쏟아부으며 반도체 초호황을 견인할 것으로 전망된다.)

On the 30th, Samsung Electronics announced that its consolidated operating profit for the first quarter (January-March) of this year surged 756.1% compared to the same period last year, reaching 57.2328 trillion won. First-quarter revenue stood at 133.8734 trillion won, and net profit was 47.2253 trillion won, up 69.2% and 474.3% year-on-year, respectively. Both first-quarter revenue and operating profit set new all-time records. Samsung Electronics had previously released preliminary results on the 7th and disclosed the confirmed figures on this day. (삼성전자는 연결 재무제표 기준 올해 1분기(1~3월) 영업이익이 57조2328억원으로 지난해 같은 기간에 견줘 756.1% 급증했다고 30일 밝혔다. 1분기 매출액은 133조8734억원, 당기순이익은 47조2253억원으로 전년 동기 대비 각각 69.2%, 474.3% 늘었다. 1분기 매출액과 영업이익은 모두 역대 최대 규모다. 앞서 삼성전자는 지난 7일 잠정실적을 공개했으며, 이날 확정 실적을 발표했다.)

According to the detailed segment performance released by Samsung Electronics on this day, the semiconductor division's operating profit in the first quarter was 53.7 trillion won, approximately 49 times higher than a year ago. This accounted for 93.8% of the company's total operating profit. This surge is attributed to the AI investment frenzy, which drove up prices of DRAM and NAND flash memory—where Samsung holds the world's largest production capacity—by nearly 90% compared to the previous quarter. The first-quarter operating profit margin (operating profit as a percentage of revenue) for the semiconductor business reached 66%. This means that for every 100,000 won memory chip sold, 66,000 won remains as profit. Considering losses (estimated at just over 1 trillion won) from the semiconductor division's system LSI and foundry (contract chip manufacturing) businesses, the profitability of the pure memory business is likely even higher. (삼성전자가 이날 공개한 사업 부문별 세부 실적을 보면, 1분기 반도체 사업부 영업이익은 53조7천억원으로 1년 전보다 약 49배 불어났다. 전사 영업이익의 93.8%가 반도체 부문에서 나온 것이다. 이는 인공지능 투자 열풍에 따른 여파로 삼성전자가 세계 최대 생산 능력을 보유한 디(D)램과 낸드플래시메모리 가격이 전 분기 대비 무려 90%가량 치솟았기 때문이다. 1분기 반도체 사업 영업이익률(매출액 대비 영업이익 비율)은 66%에 달했다. 10만원짜리 메모리 칩을 팔면 6만6천원이 마진으로 남는다는 의미다. 반도체 사업부 내 시스템 반도체(LSI)와 파운드리(반도체 수탁생산) 사업의 적자(1조원 남짓, 추정치)를 고려하면, 순수 메모리 사업 수익성은 이보다 높을 것으로 추정된다.)

In contrast, excluding semiconductors, Samsung Electronics' finished goods businesses such as smartphones and home appliances, as well as the display and automotive electronics divisions, all saw year-on-year declines in operating profit. This highlights a growing trend of "profit concentration" in semiconductors within Samsung Electronics. (반면, 반도체를 제외한 삼성전자의 스마트폰·가전 등 완제품과 디스플레이, 전장 사업부 영업이익은 전년 대비 일제히 뒷걸음질했다. 삼성전자 안에서도 반도체 ‘이익 쏠림’ 현상이 심해지고 있는 것이다.)

Kim Jae-joon, Vice President of Samsung Electronics' Memory Division, stated at the earnings conference held on this day, "The volume for this year is already fully sold out," adding, "Next year, the supply-demand gap will widen further compared to this year." This suggests that the AI-driven memory supply shortage and price strength could extend beyond this year into next. Samsung Electronics forecasts that its AI memory (HBM) revenue will more than triple year-on-year this year. In particular, the company expects that the sixth-generation product (HBM4), which began mass production shipments in February, will account for over half of total AI memory sales this year. (김재준 삼성전자 메모리부문 부사장은 이날 열린 실적 설명회에서 “올해 물량은 이미 완판된 상태”라며 “내년엔 수요 대비 공급 격차가 올해보다 더 심화할 것”이라고 했다. 인공지능발 메모리 공급 부족 및 가격 강세가 올해를 넘어 내년까지 이어질 수 있다는 관측이다. 삼성전자는 올해 인공지능 메모리(HBM) 매출이 전년 대비 3배 이상 늘어날 것으로 내다봤다. 특히 지난 2월 양산 출하를 시작한 6세대 제품(HBM4)이 올해 전체 인공지능 메모리 판매량의 절반을 넘어설 것으로 예상했다.)

Prior to Samsung Electronics' earnings announcement, on the previous day (local time), U.S. companies leading the AI investment boom—Alphabet (Google's parent company), Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta—also posted quarterly revenues and profits that exceeded market expectations, alleviating investor concerns. These four major big tech firms plan to expand their AI infrastructure investments this year to $725 billion (approximately 1,075 trillion won), up 76.8% from last year's $410 billion (about 608 trillion won). (삼성전자 실적 발표에 앞서 전날(현지시각) 인공지능 투자 붐을 이끄는 미국 알파벳(구글 모회사), 마이크로소프트(MS), 아마존, 메타 등도 일제히 시장 예상을 웃도는 분기 매출과 이익을 발표하며 시장의 우려를 일축했다. 이들 4대 빅테크는 올해 인공지능 인프라 투자 규모를 지난해(4100억달러, 약 608조원)보다 76.8% 늘어난 7250억달러(약 1075조원)로 확대할 계획이다.)

item.title: Financial Supervisory Service demands second correction to Hanwha Solutions' rights offering… "Insufficient specificity in fund usage purpose" (금감원, 한화솔루션 유상증자 두번째 정정 요구…“자금 사용목적 구체성 부족”)
item.description:
The Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) has once again put the brakes on Hanwha Solutions' reduced rights offering plan. This appears to be based on the judgment that explanations regarding the fundraising structure and the purpose of fund usage remain insufficient. (금융감독원이 한화솔루션의 축소된 유상증자 계획에도 다시 제동을 걸었다. 여전히 자금조달 구조와 사용 목적에 대한 설명이 충분치 않다는 판단으로 보인다.)

On the 30th, the FSS demanded an additional correction regarding the revised securities registration statement for the rights offering that Hanwha Solutions submitted on the 17th. This is the second request for correction, following one on the 9th. The FSS stated, "This falls under a case where formal requirements are insufficient, or the description of important matters is omitted or unclear, potentially hindering investors' rational judgment, so a request for submission of an amended registration statement was made." (금감원은 30일 한화솔루션이 지난 17일 제출한 유상증자 정정 증권신고서에 관해 추가 정정을 요구했다. 지난 9일에 이은 두 번째 정정 요구다. 금감원은 “형식 요건이 미비하거나 중요사항 기재가 누락·불분명해 투자자의 합리적 판단을 저해할 우려가 있는 경우에 해당돼 정정신고서 제출 요구를 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Hanwha Solutions had announced a rights offering worth 2.4 trillion won on the 26th of last month, but controversy escalated when it was revealed that a significant portion of the funds raised would be used for debt repayment. In response to the FSS's correction request, the company resubmitted a plan reduced by 600 billion won, totaling 1.8 trillion won. However, the FSS did not accept it this time either. (한화솔루션은 지난달 26일 2조4천억원 규모 유상증자를 발표했다가, 조달 자금의 상당 부분을 채무상환에 사용한다는 점이 알려지며 논란이 커졌다. 금감원의 정정 요구에 6천억원을 줄인 1조8천억원 수준으로 다시 제출했다. 그러나 금감원은 이번에도 수리하지 않은 것이다.)

The FSS appears to have judged that Hanwha Solutions' revised registration statement lacks specificity regarding the impact of the fundraising structure change on its finances and the purpose of fund usage. Previously, in April of last year, after the FSS once demanded a correction for Hanwha Aerospace's rights offering worth approximately 3.6 trillion won, the company reduced the size to 2.3 trillion won and resubmitted it, only to face another correction request for similar reasons. (금감원은 한화솔루션의 정정신고서가 자금조달 구조 변경이 재무에 미치는 영향과 자금 사용 목적의 구체성이 부족하다고 판단한 것으로 보인다. 금감원은 앞선 지난해 4월에 한화에어로스페이스의 약 3조6천억원 규모의 유상증자 당시 한 차례 정정 요구 이후 2조3천억원으로 규모를 줄여 재신고했지만 이런 이유로 재차 정정 요구를 한 바 있다.)

With this correction request, the effectiveness of Hanwha Solutions' revised registration statement has been suspended. If Hanwha Solutions fails to resubmit the amended registration statement within three months, the registration will be deemed withdrawn. (이번 정정 요구로 한화솔루션의 정정신고서는 효력이 정지됐다. 한화솔루션이 3개월 내 정정신고서를 다시 제출하지 않으면 신고는 철회된 것으로 간주된다.)

Hanwha Solutions stated, "We take the FSS's second correction request very seriously," and added, "We will once again humbly and deeply reflect on the criticisms and opinions raised by our shareholders and the media regarding our rights offering, and we will diligently prepare a registration statement that fully satisfies the correction requirements." (한화솔루션은 “금감원의 2차 정정요구를 매우 무겁게 받아들인다”며 “그동안 저희 유상증자에 대해 주주 여러분과 언론에서 제기해주신 지적과 의견을 겸허한 자세로 다시 한 번 깊이 새기고, 성실하게 정정요구를 충족하는 신고서를 준비하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporters: Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr, Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr, 김남일 기자 namfic@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Growing Outlook for 'BOK Rate Hike'… Oil at $100, Surprise Q1 Growth (‘한은 금리 인상’ 전망 커져…유가 100달러·1분기 깜짝 성장에)
item.description:
Amid the US-Israel and Iran war pushing international oil prices above $100 per barrel and soaring, and with first-quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth significantly exceeding initial forecasts, fueling inflation, the market's outlook for the benchmark interest rate is rapidly shifting from 'hold' to 'hike within the year'. There are even predictions that the rate could be raised twice this year. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁으로 국제 유가가 배럴당 100달러를 넘어 고공행진하는데다 지난 1분기 국내총생산(GDP·지디피) 성장률이 당초 전망치를 크게 웃아 물가 상승을 자극하면서 시장의 기준금리 향후 전망이 ‘동결’에서 ‘연내 인상’으로 급변하고 있다. 올해 금리가 두 번 오를 수 있다는 관측도 나온다.)

According to the securities industry on the 1st, various securities firms have recently predicted through reports that the Bank of Korea will raise interest rates at least once (by 0.25 percentage points) this year. This marks a significant shift from the previous stance as of late February, where a prolonged hold period was seen as highly likely, with even the possibility of a cut remaining open. Analyst Jo Yuna from Eugene Investment & Securities stated in a recent report, "Currently, we cannot be certain of a domestic rate hold, and unless there is a very severe economic downturn, there is no possibility of a cut," adding, "Although it depends on complex conditions such as the end of the Iran war and international oil price levels, it is reasonable to keep a rate hike option open and respond accordingly." <<> Analyst Ahn Ye-ha from Kiwoom Securities also predicted, "We expect at least one rate hike this year. The possibility of a hike is open in the second half of the year." <<> The reason for the dramatic shift in the outlook for the benchmark interest rate within just two months is attributed to the Iran war and the GDP growth rate of the Korean economy. The Iran war, persisting for over two months, has pushed international oil prices well above $100 per barrel, and on the 23rd of last month, the Bank of Korea announced that the real GDP growth rate for the first quarter (1.7% quarter-on-quarter) significantly exceeded initial estimates, stimulating inflation. Analyst Kang Seung-won from NH Investment & Securities commented, "Until February, if you mentioned interest rates, people would say, 'What rate hike?' While there is a possibility of a hold if oil prices stabilize, we now expect that if the war doesn't end before the May Monetary Policy Committee meeting of the BOK, they will likely have to raise rates at least once." Analyst Jo Yong-gu from Shinyoung Securities predicted, "We expect the benchmark rate to be raised in August," and added, "A second hike could then serve as an option in the first half of next year." <<> There are also forecasts that the benchmark rate could be raised twice within the year. Korea Investment & Securities predicts that the BOK will raise the benchmark rate twice—once in August and once in November. Analyst Choi Ji-wook from Korea Investment & Securities explained, "Given that the actual GDP in the first quarter showed a positive gap above the potential GDP, and financial conditions are accommodative, raising the benchmark rate twice is unlikely to contract the real economy or financial conditions." <<> In contrast, Samsung Securities expects the BOK to keep the benchmark rate on hold for the remainder of this year, forecasting two rate hikes next year. Analyst Jeong Seong-tae from Samsung Securities stated, "Considering the improving growth outlook, we are changing our forecast for the BOK benchmark rate from a long-term hold to a hold within the year and two hikes in 2027," adding, "This is based on a scenario of a ceasefire in the Middle East war during the second quarter." <<> Senior Correspondent Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (1일 증권업계에 따르면 각 증권사는 최근 보고서 등을 통해 한국은행이 올해 최소 1번(인상폭 0.25%포인트) 이상 금리를 인상할 것으로 예상하고 있다. 지난 2월 말까지만 해도 당분간 기준금리 동결 구간이 장기화될 가능성이 높고 인하 가능성까지도 열어뒀던 기존 입장에서 크게 바뀐 것이다. 조유나 유진투자증권 연구원은 최근 보고서에서 “현재로서는 국내 기준금리 동결을 확신할 수 없고, 매우 강한 경기 침체가 아니라면 인하 가능성은 없다”며 “이란 전쟁 종전 및 국제유가 수준 등 복잡한 조건부이기는 하지만, 인상을 열어놓고 대응하는 것이 합리적”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: April trade surplus hits record $23.8 billion, driven again by semiconductors (4월 무역수지 238억달러 역대 최고…반도체가 또 견인)
item.description:
Despite the prolonged US-Israel and Iran-Israel wars, exports of key products like semiconductors surged, pushing monthly exports above $80 billion for the second consecutive month. April's trade surplus reached $23.8 billion, breaking the $20 billion mark for two straight months for the first time ever. It was the largest April trade surplus on record. This marks 15 consecutive months of surplus since February last year. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화 국면에도 반도체 등 주력 제품 수출이 많이 증가하며 수출액이 두 달 연속 800억달러를 넘었다. 4월 무역수지는 238억달러 흑자를 기록하며 사상 처음 2개월 연속 200억달러를 돌파했다. 역대 4월 무역수지로는 가장 많았다. 지난해 2월부터 15개월 연속 흑자 행진이다.)

On the 1st, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy released the "April export and import trends." Exports totaled $85.9 billion, up 48% from the same month last year. This was the second-highest monthly export figure ever, following last month's record high ($86.6 billion). Among the 15 major export items, exports of eight items (semiconductors, petroleum products, petrochemicals, computers, ships, wireless communications, bio, and textiles) increased. (1일 산업통상부는 ‘4월 수출입 동향’을 발표했다. 수출은 지난해 같은 달에 견줘 48% 증가한 859억달러였다. 역대 월별 최고 수출액을 기록한 지난달(866억원)에 이어 역대 두 번째로 많았다. 15대 주력 수출품목 가운데 8개 품목(반도체, 석유제품, 석유화학, 컴퓨터, 선박, 무선통신, 바이오, 섬유)의 수출이 증가했다.)

Once again, semiconductors led the export surge. Semiconductor exports rose 173.5% year-on-year to $31.9 billion. This marked the second consecutive month exports surpassed $30 billion, following last month's all-time high of $32.8 billion. Looking at monthly semiconductor export figures since November last year, the upward trend has continued unabated: $17.3 billion → $20.8 billion → $20.5 billion → $25.1 billion → $32.8 billion → $31.9 billion. The ministry analyzed that "continued growth in demand for AI servers led to an increase in fixed memory prices." (수출을 이끈 것은 이번에도 반도체였다. 반도체 수출이 전년 동기 대비 173.5% 증가한 319억달러였다. 역대 최고치였던 지난달(328억달러)에 이어 두 달 연속 수출 300억달러를 돌파했다. 지난해 11월부터 월별 반도체 수출액 추이를 보면, 173억달러→208억달러→205억달러→251억달러→328억달러→319억달러로 상승세가 멈추지 않고 있다. 산업부는 “인공지능(AI) 서버 수요 증가가 지속되면서 메모리 고정가격이 상승했다”고 분석했다.)

The prolonged Middle East war drove international oil prices higher, significantly raising the unit price of petroleum product exports. Consequently, petroleum product exports rose 39.9% year-on-year to $5.11 billion. However, export volumes fell by 36% due to export controls on gasoline, diesel, and kerosene. (중동 전쟁 장기화로 국제 유가가 고공 행진하며 석유제품 수출 단가가 크게 상승했다. 이에 따라 석유제품 수출은 전년 동기 대비 39.9% 증가한 51억1천만달러를 기록했다. 다만 수출 물량은 휘발유·경유·등유에 대한 수출통제 영향으로 36% 감소했다.)

Automobile exports were $6.17 billion, down 5.5% year-on-year, with mixed results by vehicle type. Exports of internal combustion engine vehicles fell 17% to $3.6 billion, but exports of eco-friendly vehicles, including hybrids ($1.6 billion) and electric vehicles ($900 million), increased by 9% and 23%, respectively. The ministry attributed the decline in auto exports to "ongoing logistics disruptions from the Middle East war and expanded local production in the US due to US tariff impositions." (자동차 수출은 61억7천만달러로 전년 동기 대비 5.5% 감소했는데, 차종에 따라 희비가 갈렸다. 내연기관차 수출은 36억달러로 17% 감소했지만, 하이브리드차(16억달러)·전기차(9억달러) 등 친환경차 수출은 각각 9%, 23% 증가했다. 산업부는 자동차 수출 감소에 대해 “중동 전쟁으로 인한 물류차질 지속과 미국의 관세 부과에 따른 미국 현지생산 확대 등으로 감소세가 이어졌다”고 분석했다. )

Export performance by region showed increases in seven of the nine major export destinations: China $17.7 billion (up 62.5%), the US $16.3 billion (up 54%), ASEAN $15.4 billion (up 64%), the European Union $7.2 billion (up 8.5%), Japan $3 billion (up 28.4%), Latin America $2.9 billion (up 10%), and India $2.4 billion (up 41.9%). (지역별 수출 실적은 △중국 177억달러(62.5% 증가) △미국 163억달러(54% 증가) △아세안 154억달러(64% 증가) △유럽연합(EU) 72억달러(8.5% 증가) △일본 30억달러(28.4% 증가) △중남미 29억달러(10% 증가) △인도 24억달러(41.9% 증가) 등 9대 주요 수출지역 가운데 7개 지역 수출이 증가했다.)

Imports last month totaled $62.11 billion, up 16.7% year-on-year. Energy imports were $10.61 billion, an increase of 7.5%. Crude oil imports amounted to $7 billion (up 13.1%). The ministry stated that "while import volumes decreased due to the Middle East war, import values rose due to higher unit prices from surging oil prices." (지난달 수입은 621억1천만달러로 전년 동기 대비 16.7% 증가했다. 에너지 수입은 7.5% 늘어난 106억1천만달러였다. 원유 수입액은 70억달러(13.1% 증가)였다. 산업부는 “중동 전쟁으로 수입 물량은 감소했으나 유가 급등에 따른 수입 단가 상승으로 수입액이 증가했다”고 밝혔다.)

The trade surplus last month recorded $23.77 billion, an increase of $18.97 billion year-on-year. This was the largest April trade surplus ever. The second-largest was $12.9 billion in April 2017. (지난달 무역수지는 전년 동기 대비 189억7천만달러 증가한 237억7천만달러 흑자를 기록했다. 역대 4월 무역수지 가운데 가장 많았다. 2위는 2017년 4월 129억달러였다.)

Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jung-kwan assessed that "this result was possible because our companies preemptively secured supply chains amid the global expansion of AI investment and rising petroleum product unit prices due to oil price hikes." However, he noted, "There are concerns that export volatility could increase due to intensified competition in major items and difficulties in raw material procurement from the Middle East war," and pledged to minimize burdens on export companies through marketing, financial, and insurance support, as well as policies to diversify export markets. Minister Kim stated, "We will leverage trade networks to secure additional alternative volumes of crude oil and naphtha to create conditions where companies can continue to demonstrate global competitiveness." (김정관 산업부 장관은 “전 세계적인 인공지능 투자 확대, 유가 상승에 따른 석유제품 단가 상승 속에서 우리 기업들이 선제적으로 공급망을 확보했기 때문에 가능한 결과였다”고 평가했다. 다만 “주요 품목 경쟁 심화, 중동 전쟁에 따른 원재료 수급 어려움 등 수출 변동성이 확대될 우려가 있다”며, 마케팅·금융·보험 지원 및 수출 시장 다변화 정책 등을 통해 수출 기업 부담을 최소화하도록 노력하겠다고 했다. 김 장관은 “통상 네트워크를 활용하여 원유·나프타 등 대체 물량을 추가 확보해 기업들이 글로벌 경쟁력을 지속 발휘할 수 있는 여건을 만들어 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: One Month After WGBI Inclusion, Foreign New Buying ‘Weaker Than Expected’ (세계국채지수 편입 한달, 외국인 신규 매수세 ‘기대보다 약해’)
item.description:
It has been a month since Korean government bonds were officially included in the World Government Bond Index (WGBI) on April 1. Foreign net purchases of government bonds have increased evenly across short-term, mid-term, and long-term bonds, sparking assessments that they are revitalizing the domestic bond market. However, there is also analysis that the new buying by foreigners following the index inclusion is not as strong as initially expected. (우리 국채가 세계국채지수(WGBI)에 정식 편입(4월1일)된 지 한 달을 맞았다. 외국인의 국고채 순매수액이 단기·중기·장기채에 걸쳐 골고루 증가하면서 국내 채권시장에 활기를 주고 있다는 평가가 나온다. 다만 당초 기대했던 것보다는 지수 편입에 따른 외국인 신규 매수세가 강하지 않다는 분석도 있다.)

According to the government’s Integrated Government Bond Information System on the 1st, from March 30 to April 27, foreign net purchases of government bonds totaled 10 trillion won on a trade basis and 7.9 trillion won on a settlement basis. Even after that, net purchases continued on the 28th (10.8 billion won), 29th (251.1 billion won), and 30th (2.4227 trillion won) on a trade basis. Most recently, it marks a streak of net purchases for nine consecutive trading days since April 20. Due to bond settlement timing, foreign net purchases tend to concentrate at the end or beginning of each month. (1일 정부 국고채통합정보시스템 등에 따르면, 지난 3월30일부터 지난달 27일까지 외국인 국고채 순매수 규모는 체결 기준 10조원, 결제 기준 7조9천억원으로 각각 집계됐다. 그후에도 체결 기준으로 28일(순매수 108억원), 29일(2511억원), 30일(2조4227억원)에도 순매수를 이어갔다. 가장 최근으로는 4월20일 이후 9거래일 연속 순매수 행진이다. 채권 결제 시점으로 인해 매월 말일 또는 월초에는 외국인 순매수가 집중되는 경향이 있다.)

In this government bond distribution data, it is difficult to separately distinguish and measure the typical foreign investment amounts from the new fund inflows due to the WGBI inclusion. However, the scale of foreign net purchases of government bonds (on a trade basis) has been steadily increasing: from March 30 to April 1, it was 4.4 trillion won; to the 13th, 7.7 trillion won; and to the 21st, 8.5 trillion won. (이 국채 유통정보자료에서 기존의 통상적인 외국인 투자금액과 세계국채지수 편입에 따른 신규자금 유입 규모를 따로 구분·식별해 측정하기는 어렵다. 하지만, 외국인 국고채 순매수 규모(체결 기준)는 지난 3월30일 기준으로 지난달 1일까지 4조4천억원, 13일까지 7조7천억원, 21일까지 8조5천억원 등 꾸준히 느는 추세다.)

Buoyed by foreign net purchases of government bonds, the holding balance also rebounded. Foreign holdings of Korean government bonds increased by 3.3% from 297.1636 trillion won on March 30 to 306.7434 trillion won on April 29. (외국인의 국고채 순매수세에 힘입어 보유잔고도 반등했다. 외국인의 우리 국고채 보유잔고는 지난 3월30일 297조1636억원에서 4월29일 306조7434억원으로 3.3% 증가했다.)

Foreigners were found to be buying short-term, mid-term, and long-term bonds evenly. The Hankyoreh examined the top 10 government bond issues by foreign net purchase amount (based on value) from March 30 to April 30, finding 2.8106 trillion won in 2–3 year short-term bonds, 2.8752 trillion won in 5-year mid-term bonds, and 2.3825 trillion won in 10–30 year long-term bonds. (외국인은 단기채·중기채·장기채를 골고루 사들인 것으로 파악됐다. 한겨레가 지난 3월30일~4월30일 기간 외국인 순매수 상위(금액 기준) 10개 국채 종목을 살펴보니 단기채 2~3년물이 2조8106억원, 중기채 5년물이 2조8752억원, 장기채 10년~30년물이 2조3825억원이다.)

Initially, it was estimated that passive funds worth $50–60 billion (approximately 74–89 trillion won) would flow in by the end of this year following the WGBI inclusion. Considering the inclusion period (total of 8 months through November), when arithmetic factors are applied to the recent won-dollar exchange rate, it is estimated that an average of 8–9 trillion won per month in new funds would come in due to the inclusion effect. In the securities industry, if foreign net purchases of government bonds this month (general funds + WGBI funds) are seen at 10 trillion won, the fund inflow due to index inclusion would fall slightly short of expectations. Kim Sang-in, a researcher at Shinhan Securities, analyzed, “It seems that a significant amount of foreign bond funds came in April, but since foreign funds have been continuously flowing in since last year, it is difficult to assess the new fund inflow from this WGBI inclusion as being very large.” Ahn Hye-ha, a researcher at Kiwoom Securities, also said, “It’s true that some passive funds have flowed in after the WGBI inclusion. An appropriate amount has come in, but it’s hard to see it as more than expected.” (애초 세계국채지수 편입에 따라 올해 연내 500억~600억달러(약 74조∼89조원) 규모의 패시브 자금이 유입될 것으로 추정됐다. 편입 기간(오는 11월까지 총 8개월)을 산술적으로 고려하면 최근 원-달러 환율을 반영할 때 편입 효과로 월평균 신규자금 8조∼9조원이 들어올 것으로 추산된다. 증권가에서는 이달 외국인 국고채 순매수액(일반 자금+세계국채지수 자금)을 10조원으로 볼 경우, 지수 편입에 따른 자금 유입은 예상했던 수준보다 조금 못 미치는 정도가 될 것이라고 본다. 김상인 신한투자증권 연구원은 “4월에 외국인 채권자금이 상당 규모 들어온 것 같지만, 외국인 자금은 지난해부터 계속 유입됐기 때문에 이번 세계국채지수 편입에 따른 신규자금 유입이 그렇게 크다고는 판단하기는 어렵다”고 분석했다. 안혜하 키움증권 연구원도 “세계국채지수 편입 후 패시브 자금이 일부 유입된 건 맞다. 적정 수준은 들어왔으나 생각보다 많다고 보긴 어렵다”고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Pay 1.12 Million Won Round Trip"... Fuel Surcharge Hits Record High Starting Today (“왕복 112만원 내세요”…유류할증료 오늘부터 역대 최고 단계)
item.description:
Due to the prolonged U.S.-Israel-Iran war causing a sharp rise in international oil prices, airfares from May will include the highest-ever fuel surcharges. Compared to April, international flights will see increases of up to more than double, while domestic routes will rise by approximately 4.4 times. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 국제 유가가 급등하면서 5월부터 항공권에 역대 최고 수준 유류할증료가 붙는다. 4월 대비 국제선의 경우 최대 2배 이상, 국내선은 약 4.4배 이상 인상됐다.)

The fuel surcharges effective from May correspond to Stage 33 (470 cents per gallon or more), the highest level under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, and Transport's distance-based system. This marks the first time the highest stage has been applied since the current system was introduced in 2016. It jumped from Stage 6 in March to Stage 18 in April, and then to Stage 33 in May. This is because the average price of jet fuel in the Singapore spot market (MOPS) from March 16 to April 15, which serves as the basis for calculating fuel surcharges, hit a record high of $214.71 per barrel. (5월부터 적용되는 유류할증료는 국토교통부 거리비례제 기준 최고 단계인 33단계(갤런당 470센트 이상)에 해당한다. 최고 단계가 적용된 것은 2016년 현행 체계 도입 이후 처음이다. 지난 3월 6단계에서 4월 18단계를 거쳐 5월 33단계로 뛰었다. 전쟁 여파로 유류할증료 산정 기준인 3월16일~4월15일 ‘싱가포르 현물시장 항공유 평균 가격’(MOPS)이 역대 최고치(배럴당 214.71달러)를 찍었기 때문이다.)

Fuel surcharges are additional fees airlines charge on fares to cover cost increases due to rising oil prices. They are applied based on the ticket issuance date, not the travel date. They are calculated monthly based on the average MOPS price from the 16th of two months prior to the 15th of the previous month, and for international flights, they vary depending on the flight distance. (유류할증료는 유가 상승에 따른 비용 증가를 보전하기 위해 항공사가 운임에 따로 부과하는 금액이다. 탑승일이 아니라 발권일을 기준으로 부과된다. 전전달 16일부터 전달 15일까지의 엠오피에스 평균 가격을 기준으로 다달이 책정되며, 국제선의 경우 운항 거리에 따라 차등 적용된다.)

Accordingly, Korean Air will impose international fuel surcharges ranging from a minimum of 75,000 won to a maximum of 564,000 won per one-way ticket in May. This represents an increase of 73% to 106% compared to the previous month. Fuel surcharges for flights to the Americas and Europe, such as New York and Paris, are set at 564,000 won, meaning passengers must pay 1,128,000 won in fuel surcharges alone for a round-trip ticket. Last month, the round-trip fuel surcharge was 606,000 won. (이에 따라 대한항공은 5월 편도 기준 국제선 유류할증료를 최소 7만5천원에서 최대 56만4천원까지 부과한다. 전월 대비 73~106% 인상된 수준이다. 뉴욕·파리 등 미주·유럽 항공편 유류할증료는 56만4천원으로 책정됐는데, 왕복 기준 유류할증료로만 112만8천원을 내야 하는 셈이다. 지난달 유류할증료는 왕복 기준 60만6천원이었다.)

Asiana Airlines is also imposing fuel surcharges ranging from 85,400 won to 476,200 won per one-way ticket this month. Among low-cost carriers, for the maximum distance on international routes, Jeju Air is raising its fuel surcharge from $58 (April) to $126 (May), while T'way is increasing it from 213,900 won to 406,900 won. During the same period, domestic fuel surcharges rose from 7,700 won to 34,100 won. A family of four booking tickets to Jeju Island this month will have to pay an additional 211,200 won in round-trip fuel surcharges. (아시아나항공 역시 이달 편도 기준으로 유류할증료를 8만5400원에서 47만6200원까지 부과한다. 저가항공사의 경우, 최대거리 기준 국제선 유류할증료를 제주항공은 58달러(4월)→126달러(5월), 티웨이는 21만3900원→40만6900원으로 인상한다. 같은 기간 국내선 유류할증료는 7700원→3만4100원으로 올랐다. 이달 4인 가족이 제주도 티켓을 끊는다면 왕복 유류할증료로 21만1200원을 추가로 부담해야 한다.)

Under the current system, Stage 33 is the cap for fuel surcharges that airlines can impose. Even if oil prices rise further, airlines cannot increase fuel surcharges beyond this. As a result, the aviation industry is reducing or considering reducing some flights. Asiana Airlines initially planned to reduce a total of 8 flights on 3 international routes this month but has recently expanded the reduction to 13 flights. Jin Air, after canceling 45 round-trip flights on 8 routes in April, has decided to cancel 131 flights on 14 routes this month. (현행 체계에서 33단계는 항공사가 부과할 수 있는 유류할증료 상한이다. 유가가 이보다 치솟더라도 항공사는 유류할증료를 더는 올릴 수 없다. 이에 항공업계는 일부 항공편을 감편하거나, 이를 검토하고 있다. 아시아나항공은 이번 달 국제선 3개 노선에서 총 8회의 항공편 운항을 줄일 계획이었으나 최근 그 규모를 13회로 늘렸다. 진에어는 지난 4월 8개 노선에서 왕복 기준 45편을 비운항한 데 이어 이번 달에는 14개 노선에서 131편을 운항하지 않기로 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Apple's iPhone 17 sales surge drives 17% year-on-year revenue jump (애플, 아이폰17 판매 호조로 매출액 전년비 17% ‘껑충’)
item.description:
U.S. Apple posted revenue exceeding market expectations, driven by strong sales of its flagship products including the iPhone and Mac. (미국 애플이 아이폰·맥 등 주력 제품의 판매 호조에 힘입어 시장 예상을 뛰어넘는 매출을 기록했다.)

On the 30th (local time), Apple announced that its revenue for the second fiscal quarter of 2026 (January to March this year) reached $111.18 billion (164.2 trillion won). This marks a 16.6% increase compared to the same period last year, slightly surpassing the average Wall Street estimate of $109.7 billion. (애플은 지난 30일(현지시각) ‘2026회계연도 2분기(올해 1∼3월)’ 매출액이 1111억8천만달러(164조2천억원)를 기록했다고 밝혔다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간에 견줘 16.6% 늘어난 것이다. 월가 예상치 평균(1097억달러)도 소폭 웃돌았다.)

During this period, operating profit was $35.89 billion (53 trillion won), and net income was $29.58 billion (43.7 trillion won), up 21.3% and 19.4% year-on-year, respectively. Diluted earnings per share, accounting for potential stock dilution, was $2.01, a 21.8% increase from a year ago. (이 기간 영업이익은 358억9천만달러(53조원), 당기순이익은 295억8천만달러(43조7천억원)로 전년 대비 각각 21.3%, 19.4% 증가했다. 잠재적인 주식 물량을 고려해 전체 주식 수 대비 이익을 계산한 희석 주당순이익은 2.01달러로 1년 전보다 21.8% 늘어났다.)

The revenue growth was driven by strong sales of the smartphone 'iPhone 17,' which accounts for just over half of Apple's total revenue. iPhone sales during this period totaled $56 billion (82.7 trillion won), a sharp 21.7% increase compared to the same quarter last year. Mac revenue ($8.4 billion) also rose 5.7% year-on-year, fueled by the popularity of the budget-friendly laptop 'MacBook Neo,' which is experiencing stock shortages. (매출액 성장을 이끈 건, 전체 애플 매출의 절반 남짓을 차지하는 스마트폰 ‘아이폰17’의 판매 호조다. 이 기간 아이폰 매출액은 560억달러(82조7천억원)로 전년 동기 대비 21.7% 급증했다. 품절 사태를 겪고 있는 보급형 노트북 ‘맥북 네오’의 인기 등으로 맥 매출액(84억달러)도 1년 전보다 5.7% 늘었다.)

Service revenue, including TV and music streaming, the App Store, and iCloud subscriptions—which makes up more than a quarter of Apple's total revenue—also grew 16.3% year-on-year to $30.98 billion (45.8 trillion won). By region, China saw revenue increase 28.1% from a year ago, reaching $20.5 billion (30.3 trillion won), leading the overall revenue growth. (애플 매출의 4분의 1 이상을 차지하는 티브이(TV)·음악 스트리밍, 앱스토어, 아이클라우드 구독 등 서비스 부문 매출액도 전년 대비 16.3% 성장한 309억8천만달러(45조8천억원)를 기록했다. 지역별로는 중국 매출액이 1년 전 대비 28.1% 불어난 205억달러(30조3천억원)를 달성하며 매출 성장을 견인했다.)

During the earnings call, Apple projected that next quarter's (third fiscal quarter of 2026, April to June this year) revenue would continue to grow by 14% to 17% compared to the same period last year. This significantly exceeds the average Wall Street estimate of 9.1%. It signals confidence that headwinds such as Apple's slower artificial intelligence (AI) strategy and rising memory prices won't immediately hinder external growth. As a result, Apple's stock rose about 2% in after-hours trading following the earnings release. (애플은 이날 실적 설명회에서 다음 분기(2026회계연도 3분기, 올해 4∼6월) 매출액도 전년 동기 대비 14∼17% 늘며 성장세가 유지될 것으로 내다봤다. 이는 월가 예상치 평균(9.1%)을 큰 폭으로 상회하는 것이다. 애플의 더딘 인공지능(AI) 전략과 메모리 가격 상승 등 악재가 당장 외형 성장의 발목을 잡진 않을 거라는 자신감을 내비친 것이다. 이에 따라 이날 실적 발표 뒤 시간 외 거래에서 애플 주가는 2% 안팎 상승했다.)

Additionally, John Turners, who will succeed Tim Cook as Apple's new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) on September 1st, made a surprise appearance during the earnings call, stating, "I will carry forward (CEO Cook's) thoughtfulness, prudence, and discipline." (또 이날 실적 설명회에는 팀 쿡에 이어 오는 9월1일 애플의 새 최고경영자(CEO)를 맡게 될 존 터너스가 깜짝 등장해 “(쿡 최고경영자의) 사려깊음과 신중함, 그리고 규율을 이어갈 것”이라고 밝히기도 했다.)

item.title: 'Can't be found'…Seoul apartment jeonse supply-demand index hits highest in nearly 5 years (‘구할 수가 없네’…서울 아파트 전세수급, 5년 만에 최고)
item.description:
The jeonse supply-demand index for Seoul apartments has reached its highest level in about five years, as the number of available jeonse listings has recently declined. (최근 서울 아파트 전세 매물이 줄어들면서 전세수급지수가 약 5년 만에 최고 수준을 기록했다.)

According to the Korea Real Estate Board on the 1st, the jeonse supply-demand index for Seoul apartments in the fourth week of April (as of April 27) rose 0.5 points from the previous week to 108.9. This figure is the highest in about five years, since the fourth week of June 2021 (110.6). At that time, the implementation of the two rental housing laws in July 2020 led to an increase in cases of exercising the right to request contract renewal, reducing new jeonse listings and driving up jeonse prices. The jeonse supply-demand index is a numerical indicator of the ratio between jeonse demand and supply. A figure above 100 means there are more people seeking jeonse than those offering it. <<> By region, the northeastern region (Seongdong, Gwangjin, Dongdaemun, Jungnang, Seongbuk, Gangbuk, Dobong, Nowon) recorded the highest jeonse supply-demand index at 110.5. This was followed by the northwestern region (Eunpyeong, Seodaemun, Mapo) at 109.0, the southwestern region (Yangcheon, Gangseo, Guro, Geumcheon, Yeongdeungpo, Dongjak, Gwanak) at 108.5, the southeastern region (Seocho, Gangnam, Songpa, Gangdong) at 107.7, and the central region (Jongno, Jung-gu, Yongsan) at 106.9. <<> Jeonse listings in Seoul have significantly decreased. According to data from real estate big data company Asil, as of today, the number of Seoul apartment jeonse listings stood at 15,744 units, a 41.9% decrease from 27,095 units a year ago. Seongbuk-gu saw the largest decline among Seoul's 25 districts, with an 84.8% drop. In Gwanak-gu (99 units), Gangbuk-gu (62 units), Jungnang-gu (62 units), and Geumcheon-gu (61 units), jeonse listings are fewer than 100 units. <<> The sharp decline in jeonse listings has been significantly influenced by the strengthening of the mandatory residence requirement following last year's October 15 measures. As multi-homeowner properties previously occupied by tenants came onto the market as distressed sales, the total volume of jeonse housing decreased. Market analysts suggest that since the October 15 measures last year, the requirement for those purchasing apartments in land transaction permit zones like Seoul to reside in them for two years has been reshaping the housing market toward owner-occupiers. <<> Various other factors are also contributing to the intensifying phenomenon of jeonse demand exceeding supply. Park Won-gap, a senior real estate expert at KB Kookmin Bank, stated, "As the rate of exercising the right to request contract renewal increases, the number of properties circulating in the market appears to have significantly decreased," adding, "The aftermath of jeonse fraud has contracted the supply of non-apartment housing, and the demand escaping from villas has concentrated on apartment jeonse, further worsening the situation." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr (1일 한국부동산원에 따르면 4월 넷째주(4월27일 기준) 서울 아파트 전세수급지수는 직전 주보다 0.5포인트 오른 108.9를 기록했다. 이 수치는 2021년 6월 넷째주(110.6) 이후 약 5년 만에 가장 높은 수준이다. 당시 2020년 7월 임대차 2법 시행으로 계약갱신청구권을 행사하는 사례가 늘어나면서 신규 전세 매물이 줄고 전셋값이 치솟은 바 있다. 전세수급지수는 전세 수요와 공급 비중을 수치화한 지표로, 100을 넘으면 전세를 내놓는 사람보다 구하는 사람이 많다는 뜻이다.)

item.title: Trump and the K-shaped Economy: Tariff Burden on the Bottom 10% of U.S. Households is Three Times That of the Top 10% (트럼프와 K자 경제…미 하위 10% 가구 관세 부담, 상위 10%의 3배)
item.description:
The global economy now stands at a crossroads of immense transformation. From U.S. protectionism and geopolitical conflicts, to the reshaping of labor and capital order by artificial intelligence, deepening inequality, and the climate crisis—the landscape of globalization we once took for granted is rapidly unraveling. Lee Kang-kook, professor of economics at Ritsumeikan University, will examine the turbulent currents of the global economy and the key issues facing the South Korean economy at its center, once a month over six months. At this great turning point in international order, we will explore together what we should choose and act upon. Editor's note <<> The letter 'K' is often used to describe the recent U.S. economy—not the K of Korea, but the K-shaped divergence of wealth gaps growing ever wider. In October 2025, the New York Times reported that while the wealthy saw their consumption surge alongside rising stock prices, life for low-income groups grew harder due to inflation. According to Moody's, the top 10% of earners in the U.S. now account for nearly half of all consumption spending. It has reached a point where people say Americans live in two different worlds. <<> Inequality in the U.S. is not a new phenomenon, but the problem is that it has worsened under the Trump administration. The Trump administration argued that globalization and international trade led to U.S. trade deficits, weakened industrial competitiveness, and the loss of manufacturing jobs, and subsequently raised tariffs. Economists refuted Trump's claims, but he won the presidency again by garnering support from workers who were left behind by globalization. On April 2, 2025, the U.S. announced it would impose a 10% baseline tariff on all imports and reciprocal tariffs of 10–49% on imports from countries with which it runs a trade surplus; after further negotiations, the reciprocal tariffs took effect on August 7. In February 2026, the Supreme Court ruled Trump's reciprocal tariffs unlawful, but Trump imposed a 10% global tariff under Section 122 of the Trade Act, which allows temporary tariffs for 150 days in cases of serious balance-of-payments deficits. <<> Alongside tariffs, another pillar of 'Trump economics' is tax cuts. In July 2025, the Trump administration passed the 'One Big Beautiful Bill Act' (OBBBA). This law extends the income and corporate tax cuts from Trump's first term, which were set to expire at the end of 2025; scales back welfare spending by reducing eligibility for health insurance and food assistance programs for low-income groups; and increases defense spending and the government debt ceiling. It also includes federal income tax exemptions for overtime pay and tips, along with additional tax relief for the elderly and middle class. <<> The problem is that these tariff hikes and tax cuts have harmful effects on income distribution and exacerbate inequality. According to an analysis by the Congressional Budget Office, OBBBA's cuts to social welfare and tax breaks for the wealthy are projected to reduce after-tax income for the bottom 10% of households by an average of 3.1% annually from 2026 to 2034, while increasing it by 2.7% for the top 10%. The analysis also projected that tariff hikes would disproportionately harm low-income households, who rely more heavily on imported goods, leading to even worse outcomes for them. According to Yale University's Budget Lab, the tariff burden on the bottom 10% of households is about three times greater than that on the top 10%. For example, if Section 122 of the Trade Act remains in effect, disposable income for the bottom 10% of households is expected to fall by 2.1% annually from 2026 to 2034, compared to a 0.7% drop for the top 10%. Furthermore, criticism has been raised that Trump administration labor policies—such as reducing the minimum wage for federal workers and appointing pro-employer members to the National Labor Relations Board—also weaken workers' rights and economic stability, worsening the livelihoods of working-class households. <<> Changes in wages by income quintile also confirm that inequality has widened under the Trump administration. According to the Atlanta Federal Reserve's Wage Growth Tracker, during the post-COVID economic recovery under the Biden administration (2021–25), wage growth for lower-income workers outpaced that of higher-income workers, reducing wage inequality. The same trend was observed during Trump's first term (2017–21). However, after Trump's second term began in 2025, wage growth for low-wage workers slowed significantly, widening the gap between upper and lower tiers. This reflects a slowdown in job creation in the labor market, which is closely linked to the uncertainty caused by rapid tariff hikes. Ultimately, the Trump administration's economic policies are deepening inequality in both the primary distribution of labor market income and the secondary distribution of disposable income. Moreover, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, the labor share of GDP—the portion of income going to workers—fell to 53.8% in the third quarter of 2025, the lowest level since records began in 1947. This reality was the backdrop for the victory of Mamdani, a left-leaning Democrat who campaigned on 'affordable living costs' in last November's New York City mayoral election, advocating for rent freezes and higher taxes on the wealthy. <<> Indeed, the job situation under the Trump administration has not been favorable. In March 2026, total nonfarm payrolls increased by 178,000 from the previous month, beating expectations, and the unemployment rate fell to 4.3%. However, in February, payrolls had decreased by 133,000, indicating continued volatility. Compared to March 2025, before the tariff hikes, total employment has increased by only about 260,000, while manufacturing jobs have actually declined by 75,000—a 0.6% drop relative to total manufacturing employment. The unemployment rate for Black Americans, who are predominantly low-income, and the share of long-term unemployed (those jobless for 27 weeks or more) have also risen. The Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index, an indicator of manufacturing activity, has picked up in 2026, but it had been declining consistently through the end of 2025 after Trump took office. This is largely due to reduced export orders and imports in the manufacturing sector, which is deeply intertwined with global supply chains, amid heightened uncertainty from tariff hikes. Higher tariffs hurt U.S. companies that import intermediate goods, and the slowdown in international trade simultaneously stalls growth for both the world and the U.S. In other words, the current state of the U.S. economy does not support Trump's claim that tariff hikes will reduce the trade deficit and revive manufacturing. <<> On the other hand, the wealth of ultra-billionaires has grown even faster recently. According to Professor Zucman of the Paris School of Economics, the wealth of the top 0.00001% in the U.S.—just 19 ultra-billionaires—accounted for about 12% of national income in November 2025, up from about 10% a year earlier. This surge in billionaire wealth is driven by the skyrocketing stock market valuations of tech companies. The wealth of the top 0.00001% had already reached $2.6 trillion by the end of 2024, an increase of about $1 trillion from the end of 2023. Their share of total wealth also rose from 1.2% at the end of 2023 to 1.8% at the end of 2024. By the end of 2025, their wealth had increased by an additional $700 billion. In stark contrast to middle- and lower-income workers, the wealth of ultra-billionaires who control technology and capital in tandem with AI advancements is growing astronomically. <<> Interestingly, economic growth in 2025 was not that bad. The U.S. economy grew at 2.1% in 2025, lower than the 2.8% in 2024, but better than the feared shock from tariff hikes. Personal consumption expenditures rose 2.6%, fixed investment increased 2.7%, and equipment investment surged 8.3%. The first-quarter growth rate was -0.6% at an annualized rate quarter-over-quarter, impacted by slowing consumption and a surge in imports ahead of tariffs, but the second quarter rose to 3.8%, the third to 4.4%, and then fell to 0.5% in the fourth quarter. Personal consumption expenditure growth was low in the first quarter but rose from the second quarter onward, while fixed investment, driven by equipment investment, was particularly high in the first half. However, it is important to note that U.S. growth in 2025 was underpinned by a boom in AI-related investment, such as data center construction by big tech companies. Professor Furman of Harvard University pointed out that fixed investment in information processing equipment and software surged at an annualized rate of about 27% in the first half of 2025, and excluding this, the economic growth rate for that period was only 0.1%. Given the uncertain profit outlook for AI companies, whether such massive investments can continue remains to be seen. Furthermore, the recent U.S.-Iran war is expected to lower growth rates and push up prices, leading to stagflation. In fact, the consumer price index rose 3.3% year-over-year in March 2026, a significant increase. <<> Ultimately, the current U.S. economy is painting a K-shaped picture of widening gaps despite sustained growth. In particular, while consumer spending has steadily increased, it is driven mainly by high-income groups, and there are growing voices that this masks the reality of a diverging macroeconomy behind the growth figures. This, of course, runs counter to Trump's promise to 'Make America Great Again.' Consequently, President Trump's approval ratings have fallen since taking office, and public sentiment on prices, jobs, and the economy has turned sharply negative. Faced with the K-shaped economy, the American workers who once supported him are now turning their backs on his misguided economic policies. They are asking: Whose growth is this for? In the earlier New York Times article, a 40-year-old woman driving for Uber responded to the report of strong economic growth by asking, 'Good for whom?' It is a question we should ask ourselves as well. <<> Lee Kang-kook, Professor, Faculty of Economics, Ritsumeikan University (세계 경제는 지금 거대한 전환의 길목에 서 있다. 미국의 보호무역주의와 지정학적 갈등, 인공지능이 바꾸는 노동과 자본의 질서, 심화하는 불평등과 기후위기까지, 우리가 당연하게 여겼던 세계화의 풍경이 빠르게 해체되고 있다. 이강국 리쓰메이칸대 경제학 교수가 매월 한 차례, 6개월에 걸쳐 격변하는 세계 경제의 흐름과 그 한가운데 놓인 한국경제의 쟁점을 짚는다. 국제 질서의 거대한 전환점에서, 우리는 무엇을 선택하고 실천해야 할지 함께 살펴볼 예정이다. 편집자 주)

item.title: Hanwha, Ranked 5th in Chaebol, Faces Controversy with Each Rights Offering… Criticism for Neglecting Responsible Management and Shareholder Protection (‘재계 5위’ 한화, 유상증자 때마다 논란…책임경영·주주보호 소홀 비판)
item.description:
Every time Hanwha pushes for a large-scale rights offering, financial regulatory authorities repeatedly step in to halt it, demanding clarification on the funding structure and purpose of use. The background of these rights offerings often invites controversies over succession maneuvering and criticism for shifting responsibility for management failures. Observers point out that rather than taking an approach of "it will be resolved if the stock price rises," Hanwha needs to restore market trust befitting its status as the fifth-largest conglomerate. (한화가 대규모 유상증자를 추진할 때마다 금융감독 당국이 잇달아 제동을 걸고, 자금조달 구조와 사용 목적 소명을 요구하는 일이 반복되고 있다. 유상증자 배경을 두고 경영권 꼼수 승계 논란, 경영실패 책임 전가 비판이 따라붙는다. ‘주가가 오르면 해결된다’는 식의 접근이 아닌, 재계 순위 5위에 걸맞는 시장 신뢰 회복이 필요하다는 지적이 나온다.)

On the night of the 30th, the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) demanded additional corrections to the rights offering amendment securities report submitted by Hanwha Solutions on the 17th. This marks the second correction request following one on the 9th. The FSS stated the reason for the additional correction request, saying, "This applies to cases where the format is not properly adhered to, or where false statements, omissions, or unclear material facts hinder investors' reasonable investment decisions or cause significant misunderstandings." (금융감독원은 30일 밤 한화솔루션이 지난 17일 제출한 유상증자 정정 증권신고서에 대해 추가 정정을 요구했다. 지난 9일에 이은 두 번째 정정 요구다. 금감원은 “형식을 제대로 갖추지 않은 경우, 중요사항 거짓 기재·누락·불분명함으로 인해 투자자의 합리적 투자 판단을 저해하거나 투자자에게 중대한 오해를 일으킬 수 있는 경우에 해당한다”고 추가 정정 요구 이유를 밝혔다.)

On the 26th of last month, two days after its regular shareholders' meeting, Hanwha Solutions announced plans for a rights offering worth 2.4 trillion won, using a shareholder allocation method. Since the new shares issued amounted to over 40% of the existing shares, diluting stock value was inevitable. Additionally, the company revealed that 60% of the funds raised from shareholders, amounting to 1.4899 trillion won, would be used to repay corporate debt rather than for future investments like facilities, sparking strong backlash from ordinary shareholders. Amid criticism that management failures were being passed onto shareholders, the stock price plummeted. (한화솔루션은 정기 주주총회 이틀 뒤인 지난달 26일 2조4천억원 규모 주주배정 방식 유상증자를 추진한다고 발표했다. 기존 주식수의 40%가 넘는 대규모 신주 발행이어서 주식 가치 희석이 불가피한데다, 주주로부터 조달한 자금의 60%인 1조4899억원을 시설 등 미래 투자가 아닌 회사 빚을 갚는 데 쓰겠다고 밝혀 일반 주주들의 강한 반발을 샀다. 경영 실패 책임을 주주에게 떠넘긴다는 비판과 함께 주가는 곤두박질쳤다.)

Adding to the controversy were remarks by a Hanwha Solutions executive about "prior communication with the FSS." The FSS then demanded on the 9th that Hanwha Solutions correct the rights offering plan, citing insufficient explanations of fund usage and necessity. In response, Hanwha Solutions resubmitted a revised plan on the 17th, reducing the debt repayment portion by 600 billion won and scaling the rights offering to 1.8 trillion won. As part of practicing responsible management, Kim Seung-yeon, chairman of Hanwha Group, said he would forgo receiving a salary from Hanwha Solutions. However, the FSS deemed this insufficient and requested further corrections. (한화솔루션 임원의 ‘금감원과의 사전 소통’ 발언 논란까지 불거진 가운데, 금감원은 지난 9일 자금 사용 목적과 필요성 등에 대한 설명 부족 등을 이유로 한화솔루션에 유상증자 계획 정정을 요구했다. 이에 한화솔루션은 17일 채무 상환 비중을 6천억원 줄인 1조8천억원 규모 유상증자 계획을 다시 제출했다. 책임경영 실천 차원에서 김승연 한화그룹 회장이 한화솔루션으로부터 급여를 받지 않겠다고 했다. 그런데 금감원은 이마저도 수용하기 어렵다며 재차 정정을 요구한 것이다.)

The specific reasons for the FSS's correction request are confidential. However, it is speculated that the FSS may view Hanwha's recent large-scale rights offering plans as tilted in favor of management, failing to align with the strengthened protection of ordinary shareholders and capital market normalization efforts, such as the recent amendment to the Commercial Law expanding directors' fiduciary duties. (금감원의 구체적 정정 요구 사유는 보안 사항이다. 다만 최근 한화 쪽이 내놓는 대규모 유상증자 계획이 경영진 쪽에 기울어져, 이사의 충실 의무 확대 등 최근 상법 개정으로 강화된 일반 주주 보호, 자본시장 정상화 흐름에 부합하지 않는다고 봤을 가능성이 제기된다.)

Last year, the FSS also applied strict scrutiny to Hanwha Aerospace's rights offering, issuing two correction requests. At that time, Hanwha Aerospace decided on a massive 3.6 trillion won rights offering to secure funds for investments in defense and other areas. Just before announcing the plan, Hanwha Aerospace purchased Hanwha Energy's stake in Hanwha Ocean for 1.3 trillion won. Hanwha Energy is wholly owned by Chairman Kim Seung-yeon's three sons (Dong-kwan, Dong-won, and Dong-seon). This sparked controversy over the rights offering being a tactic to secure funds for management succession. As the controversy escalated, Chairman Kim Seung-yeon abruptly donated half of his stake in the holding company, Hanwha Corp., to his three sons to quell the dispute. (금감원은 지난해에도 한화에어로스페이스 유상증자에 깐깐한 심사 잣대를 적용해 두 차례 정정 요구를 한 바 있다. 당시 한화에어로스페이스는 방산 등 투자 재원 마련 목적으로 3조6천억원에 달하는 대규모 유상증자를 결정했다. 한화에어로스페이스는 유상증자 계획 발표 직전 한화에너지가 가진 한화오션 지분을 1조3천억원에 사들였다. 한화에너지는 김승연 회장의 세 아들(동관, 동원, 동선)이 지분 100%를 소유하고 있다. 경영권 승계 실탄 마련을 위한 꼼수라는 논란이 커졌다. 유상증자 계획이 경영권 승계 논란으로 번지자, 김승연 회장은 지주회사 격인 ㈜한화 지분 절반을 세 아들에게 전격 증여해 논란 해소에 나섰다.)

At the time, Lee Jae-myung, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, weighed in on the controversy, sharing ordinary shareholders' criticism on Facebook that the company "treats the capital market as an ATM" and noting, "This is not uncommon in our capital market," highlighting the need to push for amendments to the Commercial Law. Eventually, Hanwha had to take remedial measures by having Hanwha Energy purchase 1.3 trillion won worth of new Hanwha Aerospace shares, returning the "ammunition" it had previously received, and reducing the rights offering scale accordingly. (당시 이재명 더불어민주당 대표는 이 논란에 뛰어들어 “자본 시장을 현금 인출기로 여긴다”는 일반 주주들의 비판을 페이스북에 옮기며, “우리 자본 시장에서는 드물지 않게 일어나는 일”이라며 상법 개정 추진 필요성을 거론하기도 했다. 결국 한화 쪽은 한화에어로스페이스 신주를 한화에너지가 1조3천억원어치 매입하는 방식으로 이전에 받았던 ‘실탄’을 되돌려주고, 유상증자 규모는 그만큼 줄이는 수습책을 내놓아야 했다.)

Hanwha Solutions responded to the FSS's second correction request the previous day, stating, "We take this seriously. We will humbly and deeply reflect on the criticisms and opinions raised by shareholders and the media regarding the rights offering, and diligently prepare a report that meets the correction requirements." (한화솔루션은 전날 금감원의 2차 정정 요구에 대해 “무겁에 받아들인다. 그동안 유상증자에 대해 주주 여러분과 언론에서 제기한 지적과 의견을 겸허한 자세로 다시 한 번 깊이 새기고, 성실하게 정정요구를 충족하는 신고서를 준비하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr (김남일 기자 namfic@hani.co.kr)

item.title: '2X Samsung & SK Hynix ETF' to Launch This Month...“Lottery-like Nature, Frequent Surges but Rare Jackpots” (‘삼전·닉스 2배 ETF’ 이달 출시…“복권 같은 성격, 급등 잦아도 당첨 드물어”)
item.description:
Single-stock leveraged exchange-traded funds (ETFs) based on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will be listed for the first time on the 22nd of this month. With over 2,000 applicants for the mandatory pre-trading education course that began on the 28th of last month, market interest is high. However, unlike general ETFs, these products offer low diversification, requiring caution. (삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스를 기초자산으로 하는 단일종목 레버리지 상장지수펀드(이티에프·ETF) 상품이 이달 22일 처음 상장된다. 지난달 28일부터 시작된 사전교육 신청자가 첫날부터 2천명 이상 몰리며 시장의 관심이 뜨거운 가운데 일반 이티에프와 달리 분산효과가 낮다는 점 등에 주의가 요구된다.)

On the 1st, after attending the 'Pre-trading Education for Single-Stock Leveraged and Inverse Listed Products' opened by the Korea Financial Investment Association, it was noted that single-stock ETFs apply the same characteristics as general stock investments while adding leveraged or inverse effects, thereby increasing risk. Domestic equity-type ETFs typically consist of portfolios with at least 10 stocks, offering built-in risk diversification. Therefore, they focus more on market or industry trends, making a 'top-down' approach—analyzing macroeconomic factors first—more useful. In contrast, single-stock ETFs track the price and performance of individual stocks, offering no inherent diversification and fully exposing investors to the price risk of a single stock. As they are more sensitive to an individual company's performance rather than market or economic trends, a 'bottom-up' approach focusing on the company's intrinsic value and earnings is necessary. (1일 금융투자협회가 개설한 ‘단일종목 레버리지·인버스 상장상품 거래’ 사전교육을 직접 들어보니, 단일종목 이티에프 상품은 일반 주식투자의 특성이 동일하게 적용되는 동시에 레버리지·인버스 효과가 부가돼 위험도가 추가됐다는 특징이 있다. 국내 상장되는 주식형 이티에프의 경우 최소 10종목 이상으로 구성하는 포트폴리오 방식이기 때문에 자체적으로 위험을 분산하는 기능이 있다. 따라서 편입된 개별 종목보다는 시장이나 산업의 흐름에 주목하기 때문에 거시적인 면을 먼저 분석하는 ‘탑다운’ 방식이 유용하다. 이와 달리 단일종목 이티에프는 개별 종목의 가격·성과를 추적하기 위해 투자하는 상품이기 때문에 자체 분산효과를 기대할 수 없고, 단일종목의 가격 위험에 그대로 노출된다. 시장이나 경기동향보다 개별 기업의 실적 등에 민감하기 때문에 기업 자체의 가치·실적에 집중하는 ‘바텀업’ 방식으로 접근해야 한다.)

Hence, when investing in single-stock ETFs, it's crucial to remember that it's 'akin to buying volatility.' Individual stocks tend to have wider price swings than market indices like the KOSPI, so single-stock ETFs can experience double-digit gains or losses in a single day. Jeon Gyun, a director at Samsung Securities, said during the lecture, "You must be prepared for even small price fluctuations to lead to significant losses. If you can't accept this, you should refrain from investing in single-stock ETF products." (따라서 단일종목 이티에프에 투자할 때는 ‘변동성을 매수하는 것과 같다’는 점을 유념해야 한다. 개별 주식은 코스피 등 시장지수보다 등락폭이 큰 편이므로, 단일종목 이티에프는 하루에도 두 자리 이상의 수익이나 손실이 발생할 수 있다. 강의에 나선 전균 삼성증권 이사는 “소폭의 주가 변동도 큰 손실로 이어질 수 있다는 점을 감내해야 한다. 이를 받아들이기 어렵다면 단일종목 이티에프 상품에 대한 투자는 자제해야 한다”고 말했다.)

The securities industry is hastening preparations to launch single-stock ETFs. According to a report titled 'Analysis of the Impact of Listing Single-Stock Leveraged ETFs' published by Shinhan Investment Corp. the previous day, eight asset management companies are preparing to list single-stock ETFs. With a limit of two products per company, a total of 16 products are expected to be listed. Major firms are preparing leveraged ETFs for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, while some smaller firms plan to simultaneously list leveraged and inverse 2x (gobus) ETFs on the same assets. This is expected to intensify competition, including reductions in management fees. (증권가에선 단일종목 이티에프 상품을 출시할 채비를 서둘러 갖추고 있다. 신한투자증권이 전날 발간한 ‘단일종목 레버리지 이티에프 상장 영향력 분석’ 보고서를 보면, 단일종목 이티에프 상장을 준비 중인 운용사는 8곳으로, 1사 2상품으로 제한되면서 총 16개 상품이 상장될 예정이다. 대형사들은 삼성전자와 에스케이하이닉스 레버리지를 준비 중이며 일부 중소형사들은 동일자산에 대한 레버리지, 곱버스(인버스 2배) 이티에프를 동시에 상장할 계획이라고 한다. 이로 인해 운용보수 인하 등 경쟁이 치열할 것으로 보인다.)

The report analyzed cases in the U.S., where single-stock ETFs are already traded, noting that "as blue-chip stocks are listed as leveraged ETFs, extreme price returns become more frequent, strengthening their lottery-like nature. This means that while the probability of hitting the jackpot is low, sudden surges become more common." There are concerns that the growing concentration of the domestic stock market around Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix could lead to increased short-term volatility for leading stocks if single-stock ETFs, already popular overseas, launch in Korea. (이 보고서는 이미 단일종목 이티에프가 거래되고 있는 미국 사례를 분석하며 “우량주가 레버리지 이티에프로 상장되면서 (주가 수익률) 극단치가 더 빈번하게 발생하며 복권 같은 성격이 강화된다. 당첨될 확률이 높지 않지만, 어느 날 갑자기 급등하는 경우는 빈번해진다는 뜻”이라고 설명했다. 특히 삼전·에스케이하이닉스를 중심으로 한 국내 증시 쏠림 현상이 점차 심화하고 있어, 이미 해외에서 인기를 끌고 있는 단일종목 이티에프가 국내 상륙할 경우 주도주 중심의 단기 변동성 확대로 연결될 우려도 제기된다.)
